scope: Signing panel, manual paper attestation, signer configuration and correction recovery in autonomous DEMO
implemented: Signers display separate capacities; paper completion displays actual attested names without implying verified EDS.
Unavailable connectors, missing or revoked frozen bindings, rendering failures and cancelled/replaced issuances have distinct explanations and recovery.
Settings navigation focuses the signatory section and safely returns to the request's signing panel.
Paper fields reuse frozen role names, require an explicit date/reason/attestation, preserve input and replay the exact body after an unknown response.
Signing reads and mutations ignore stale selection responses; active digital signing stays pinned to its issuance; successful mutations are not reported as failures because of refresh errors.
Signing state and endpoints prevent new digital signatures on paper-completed PDFs and new paper records on fully digitally signed PDFs, including an in-flight verifier race.
Automatic selection uses an active authority when the same account has a revoked role before another eligible role.
Identical signatory saves retain the same binding ID; explicit exact-ID revocation works for demoted or disabled accounts without revoking a newer replacement.
Working requests expose correction recovery; the operator explicitly chooses the frozen source issuance.
A concise Russian operator guide is included in docs/operator-signing.txt.
